scope: Selected school options listed in Hartford Public Schools' 2026-27 guide, plus A.I. Prince Technical High School. Out-of-city entries in the HPS guide are excluded.
purpose: Searchable school contact directory for connecting students and families to their school and its student-life supports.

sources.name: Hartford Public Schools 2026-27 School Choice Guide
sources.used_for: School names, grades, school type, address, phone, and district student/family services.

sources.name: Connecticut Technical Education and Career System: Schools
sources.used_for: A.I. Prince Technical High School location and contact details.

sources.name: EdSight Find Schools and Districts
sources.used_for: Official live entry point for the state school directory and exportable EdSight reports.

limitations: This is a curated school directory, not a complete census of every public, private, and magnet school in Hartford and not a download of EdSight performance reports.
The Hartford Public Schools guide notes that school information can change; confirm current details with the school or district.
